author: _catwu
text:
Today we shared that Anthropic acquired @bunjavascript

We've been close partners with @jarredsumner and the Bun team for months. Our collaboration drove the recent Claude Code native installer launch, and they’ve been a big part of how quickly our team moves.

Bun stays open

quoted.text:
Anthropic is acquiring @bunjavascript to further accelerate Claude Code’s growth.

We're delighted that Bun—which has dramatically improved the JavaScript and TypeScript developer experience—is joining us to make Claude Code even better.

Read more: https://t.co/aQd3XRdUfR

author: _catwu
text:
try the frontend design skill to make beautiful green field apps!

open claude code and run these two commands:
/plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-code /plugin install frontend-design@claude-code-plugins

excited to see what you build

quoted.text:
Opus 4.5 is our best model yet for design & vision. 

Here are some of my favorite UIs we made with Claude Code's frontend-design plugin. https://t.co/QKhVcwig0j

author: _catwu
text: Hit `shift + tab` twice to enter Plan Mode and verify Claude Code’s execution plan before it makes code changes. Paired with Opus 4.5, Plan Mode just got even more powerful.

quoted.text:
Plan Mode is the most slept-on feature in Claude Code – and we just made it a lot better.

It dramatically improves your one-shot success rate. Fewer iterations, less hand-holding, better final results.

Shift + Tab twice to try it. https://t.co/4kWu5EP2Ae

author: _catwu
text:
Claude Desktop now supports "multi-clauding" for both local and cloud sessions. 

This has been one of our top requests. Excited to see what you build with it!

quoted.text:
We've brought Claude Code to our Desktop app.

You can now easily run multiple Claude Code sessions locally or in the cloud and switch between them. https://t.co/0tijv6ItB3

author: _catwu
text: Use `&` in the CLI to send a session to Claude Code on the web / mobile!

quoted.text:
@_catwu @_catwu session syncing will be a great feature.

I would want to run a /sync-session it pushes the current session to claude code, so that I can use it on my phone

author: _catwu
text:
We're giving Pro and Max users free usage credits for Claude Code on the web.

Since launching, your feedback has been invaluable for improving Claude Code. We’re temporarily adding free usage so you can more flexibly experiment with the product. https://t.co/pJVBeoY3Kh

author: _catwu
text: my fav use case for claude code on the web! https://t.co/IXqOsaGnH0

author: _catwu
text:
We've shipped sandbox support in Claude Code CLI to make the CLI safer and faster.

From internal usage, we've found that using the sandbox reduces permission prompts by 84% so that you can focus on the most important permissions

author: _catwu
text:
We're so excited to launch Claude Code on the web and iOS app today!

This has become a daily driver for many of us on the Claude Code team. Here are a few of our favorite ways to use it:

quoted.text:
Introducing Claude Code on the web.

You can now delegate coding tasks to Claude without opening your terminal. https://t.co/Hw8KkKiFGj

author: _catwu
text:
Haiku 4.5 is a workhorse that makes the coding experience in Claude Code feel really fast.

While Sonnet 4.5 remains the default, Haiku 4.5 now powers the Explore subagent which can rapidly gather context on your codebase to build apps even faster. https://t.co/n2Xmh5xz4L

author: _catwu
text:
We launched plugins! 

Run `claude update` and then the slash command `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-code`

quoted.text:
Today we're announcing Claude Code plugins!

https://t.co/WD2TfN8d3d

It's the first major feature in Claude Code that I've gotten the opportunity to lead, and I'm really excited to see how everyone uses it! 🧵1/4

author: _catwu
text: We also heard you that some users hit Opus limits faster than expected. We just made a one-time reset of rate limits and advise switching from Opus to Sonnet 4.5 with /model to get the most out of your subscription

author: _catwu
text: I polled the Claude Code team and everyone now uses Sonnet 4.5 as a their daily driver! We think it’s the strongest all-around coding model and are excited for you to use it. https://t.co/Ic6Mv9fN4z

quoted.text:
The response to Sonnet 4.5 has been incredible. We've also seen some people hitting weekly limits, particularly if you're using Opus.

We've just reset limits for all paid users to give everyone a fresh start with Sonnet 4.5.

author: _catwu
text: We just shipped a bunch of updates to Claude Code, making it a more capable agent than ever. And on top of it: it’s now powered by Claude Sonnet 4.5.

quoted.text:
Introducing Claude Sonnet 4.5—the best coding model in the world.

It's the strongest model for building complex agents. It's the best model at using computers. And it shows substantial gains on tests of reasoning and math. https://t.co/7LwV9WPNAv

author: _catwu
text: I sat down with @alexalbert__ to talk about how the Claude Code team builds features, emerging behaviors like "multi-Clauding," and what's next for the Claude Code SDK for building agents! https://t.co/okgvjQz05E

author: _catwu
text:
As a reminder, you can toggle between modes (default, auto-accept, and plan) with Shift+Tab.

This setting is available now to all Claude Code users with Opus access in the latest Claude Code update.

author: _catwu
text:
To try it out, select “Opus plan mode” in the model selector (/model).

You get the benefit of Opus 4.1’s intelligence for planning and Sonnet 4’s speed (and lower cost) for execution.

author: _catwu
text:
Claude Code has a new /model option: Opus for plan mode.

This setting uses Claude Opus 4.1 for plan mode and Claude Sonnet 4 for all other work—getting the best of both models while maximizing your usage. https://t.co/puU31tqO3n

author: _catwu
text:
Status lines are customizable and let you display almost anything in your terminal.

Display contextual info that helps your workflow, like git branch or local directory. You can even display the weather or a digital buddy that keeps you company while coding. https://t.co/86FVm0imNC

author: _catwu
text:
Claude Code can now handle long-running tasks in the background.

Start your dev server, run tests, or build your project without blocking your workflow https://t.co/Xm4897eTKu

author: _catwu
text:
You can now connect to remote MCP servers from Claude Code, letting you customize Claude Code to use your favorite tools.

Pull context from your tools directly into Claude Code without context switching. https://t.co/Xzq9hWwGhW

author: _catwu
text:
Since we originally built Claude Code as an internal tool, we've heard a ton of questions about how our teams use it at Anthropic.

Here’s an inside look on how our teams—from product engineering, to growth marketing, to legal—use Claude Code: https://t.co/YnCpVZHEqA

author: _catwu
text: Claude users with a Pro plan: You can now try Claude Code!

quoted.text: Big news: Claude Code is now included in the Claude Max subscription! https://t.co/WQgMtxKsva

author: _catwu
text:
I'm blown away by Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 4. I can hand it entire feature requests and let it run for an hour+ in the background.   

These new models are now live to Claude Code users. Run `/model` to select the model. Get started here - 
https://t.co/wbJhWHsewH 🎉

author: _catwu
text:
Finally: Real-time steering.

Send feedback to Claude Code while it's working, without waiting for completion.

Claude incorporates your input immediately, adjusting its approach based on new requirements or clarifications. https://t.co/cRnBtKveGN

author: _catwu
text: Big news: Claude Code is now included in the Claude Max subscription! https://t.co/WQgMtxKsva

author: _catwu
text:
We've recently shipped a fresh batch of Claude Code features to improve your workflow! These updates make Claude Code faster, more visual, and easier to control.

Here's what's new: https://t.co/XpTsTDV3PK

author: _catwu
text:
Press # to instruct Claude Code to add a memory.

Then, type your memory and hit Enter to add it to the https://t.co/26OZQQqA00 file.

We use it to remember project conventions, architecture decisions, or coding standards that we want to reference across sessions. https://t.co/ozQNadCeUz

author: _catwu
text:
A new feature release for Claude Code: you can now quickly add memories to the https://t.co/26OZQQqA00 file using the # key.

Tell Claude Code to remember specific tips and best practices, and it’ll reference that information as context in future sessions.

Here’s how it works: https://t.co/gPrlcdIN4b

author: _catwu
text:
It’s been a big week for Claude Code.

We launched 8 exciting new features to help devs build faster and smarter.

Here's a roundup of everything we released: https://t.co/dDJqevmaXO

author: _catwu
text:
Paste a URL directly into Claude Code, and it will use the content from that webpage as context.

Perfect for pulling in documentation, specs, or reference implementations without leaving your terminal. https://t.co/ZMzmwYtAuC

author: _catwu
text:
Wrapping up our week of Claude Code updates with a much-requested feature: web fetch.

This eliminates a major context-switching pain point. Here's how it works: https://t.co/yLkoAWLD1s

author: _catwu
text:
Three more features for Claude Code today:

First, auto-accept mode.

Press Shift+Tab to toggle on auto-accept for file edits. This reduces friction while keeping you in the driver’s seat—you can tab in/out of auto-accept mode anytime. https://t.co/1WwoWbeWF2

author: _catwu
text:
Another batch of features for Claude Code!

Up first: Vim mode. This gives you the familiar insert/command modes for editing your prompts in Claude Code. Turn it on by typing the slash command /vim.

But that's not all: https://t.co/0t4qRXVTht

author: _catwu
text:
We've just shipped a new feature in Claude Code: extended thinking. You can simply ask Claude to “think”, “think more”, or “think harder” and it’ll show its extended thinking process.

This is all powered by our hybrid reasoning model, Claude 3.7 Sonnet. https://t.co/KHMzNKca59

author: _catwu
text:
`npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`

there's no more waitlist. have fun!
